prompts.character-master-v03:
Use case: style-transfer and character design.
Create ONE 16:9 model sheet for Bytefront Studio's recurring fictional adult explainer character. This is a design revision toward the ACTUAL ANIMATION style in input images 1 and 2, not the polished storybook illustration in input 3.
INPUT 1: actual Math in AI film, primary source for flat drawing style, paper, contour, teal outfit.
INPUT 2: actual Math in AI film, primary source for flat printed shapes and offset ink.
INPUT 3: earlier channel banner, secondary reference for the direction of an endearingly awkward human; do NOT retain its rounded Disney-like glossy illustrative rendering or red clown nose.

Style: 1950s printed educational cartoon, dry dark brown outlines, thin-to-medium uneven weight, solid muted teal/mustard/coral/navy fills, slight off-register fill shifted 2px from contour, flat shadow shape only, restrained warm ivory paper. Simple geometric cutout construction like input 1. No airbrush, no volumetric shading, no knitted texture, no pencil hatching, no soft toy or baby proportions.
Character: clearly adult but endearingly odd, about 4 heads tall; broad asymmetric bean head, medium large blunt bent triangular nose matching skin color (NOT red bulb), small oval cream eyes with tiny black pupils, one brow higher, short uneven dark hair with three crooked tufts, one ear more visible, small crooked mouth. Shorter and stockier than the tall researcher in input 1, mild slouch. Loose muted teal crewneck, simple mustard rectangular hem patch on character's LEFT front side only, short navy trousers, large flat cream shoes. No glasses, no tie, no buttons, no formal cardigan. Consistent identity across views. Not a child.
Layout: beautifully spaced production model sheet on warm cream with three full-body views across left two thirds (front, three-quarter, side), and four face expressions in two-by-two grid on right (curious, doubtful, surprised, small pleased smile). Small circular head portrait bottom center if room. Simple flat marks, no scenery.
Exact text only: "BYTEFRONT STUDIO" at top left; small "CHARACTER / 03" at top right.
No scheduling, weekdays, times, weekly, calendar, subtitles, watermark, extra copy. Full body visible with ample breathing room. One coherent character, not different alternatives.
prompts.channel-lockup-v03:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create ONE finished flat YouTube channel banner, landscape 16:9 full canvas, preferably 2560x1440. Input 1 is the approved-for-this-draft CHARACTER MASTER: preserve exactly this person's hair, long blunt triangular nose, uneven brows, eyes, face outline, teal loose crewneck and mustard hem patch. Input 2 is the primary STYLE REFERENCE from the Math in AI animated film. Match its simple flat printed colors, broken dark brown outlines, very subtle paper grain and slight off-register ink. Avoid glossy or dimensional children's-book painting.
Most important layout constraint: this is a FULL TV CANVAS WITH LARGE EMPTY TOP AND BOTTOM, NOT a tightly cropped wide strip. All important artwork and ALL letters must fit in the central 54% of width and central 23% of height: x=600..1960, y=555..885 at 2560x1440. Leave the remaining top and bottom mostly empty ivory paper. Do not zoom in to fill canvas. Do not draw guides or borders.
Inside that compact center strip, at left a small waist-up version of the same awkward-curious adult character, looking toward the title. Character casually rests an elbow on a simple printed horizontal rule and holds a mustard pencil, readable hand contact, little inquisitive raised brow. Whole character visible inside safe strip including hair. Head should feel odd and warm, no red clown nose.
To right, title in ONE LINE, exact mixed case "Bytefront Studio", chunky slab serif similar to Alfa Slab One, dark espresso ink with very small mustard registration offset. Title neither bubbly nor script. Under title, small clean geometric sans tagline "Stay curious. Look closer." Under tagline two small but readable labels on ONE LINE: "Byte by Byte · Deep dives" then a short divider then "Espresso · Tech Shorts".
The reference character sheet's labels are not to be repeated. No other text. NO Weekly, news schedule, dates, times, badges, websites, clocks, calendar.
Palette: ivory #F6EEDC, espresso #30251F, teal #298779, mustard #DCAF35, small coral #D9654E. Warm restrained paper. Slight sparse geometric accents may live far outer corners but no distracting illustrations. Do not use gradients, cast shadows or heavy distressed type. Output actual banner artwork, no mockup and no presentation.
prompts.channel-banner-v03-safe:
Edit target: this exact Bytefront Studio banner. ONE CHANGE ONLY: zoom out / expand blank paper around the existing whole composition. Keep all lettering, character, colors, positioning relative to each other, and spelling exactly as in the input.
The input composition is too large for YouTube phone cropping. Scale the ENTIRE existing artwork group (character + title + all three text lines + horizontal baseline + tiny decoration) down to SIXTY PERCENT of its current relative size, centered horizontally and vertically in a new 16:9 full canvas. In final output the group must occupy only x=26%..74% and y=40%..60% of the canvas. Leave huge uninterrupted warm ivory paper space around it: top forty percent blank, bottom forty percent blank, left and right twenty-six percent blank. The title must not span most of image. Do not trim the blank space. Do not crop in.
Output one 16:9 full banner, preferably 2560x1440, compact design occupying less than half the canvas width at center. No new elements, no new lettering, no frame, no guide. Preserve exact text: Bytefront Studio / Stay curious. Look closer. / Byte by Byte · Deep dives / Espresso · Tech Shorts.
prompts.avatar-v03:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Create one square channel avatar for Bytefront Studio using exactly the fictional ADULT character in input 1. Input 2 is its established banner for visual continuity.
Keep the precise recognizable long blunt triangular nose (skin colored), broad bean face, short messy dark hair with three crooked tufts, uneven eyebrows, small oval ivory eyes, tiny black pupils, small crooked smile, and simple teal crewneck. Do not make a new person. Same flat midcentury printed cartoon as the reference: dark espresso outline, muted teal fill, light cream skin, tiny off-register fill edge, very subtle dry paper grain, no gradients or soft volume.
Composition: head and upper shoulders centered in a square, portrait takes 72% of width and height; all hair, ears, nose and shoulders fit comfortably inside an imaginary central circle. Warm mustard yellow background edge to edge, no actual circular border. Curious pleased expression looking slightly upward to viewer right. No hands and no props.
No words, letters, logos, schedule, clock, watermark or shadow. Especially no exaggerated shiny eyes, red round nose, eyeglasses, small baby body or 3D shading. Output one clean profile avatar asset, not a sheet or mockup.
prompts.byte-by-byte-id-keyframe-v03:
Use case: logo-brand, illustration-story.
Create one 16:9 widescreen VIDEO ID TITLE FRAME for "Byte by Byte", the deep-explainer series of Bytefront Studio.
Input 1 locks the recurring adult human character identity, all facial details and teal loose crewneck with mustard hem patch, navy trousers, cream shoes. Input 2 is the PRIMARY visual style from the actual Math in AI film: simple geometric flat silhouettes, muted mustard solid background with subtle dry paper, espresso broken outlines, tiny misregistered fills, no dimensional painted shading.
The frame should look like a scene from that printed educational animation, not a polished marketing poster.
Layout: mustard background. On left third, full-body short stocky awkward-curious adult character leans forward, one eyebrow lifted. He has lifted a small coral paper flap with one hand; fingers visibly grip the flap edge. Under flap are three simple connected round dots, a visual hint of discovering how things work, no equations. Modest off-white paper work surface near waist. The character acts on a real prop rather than standing and pointing.
Right half: very large dark espresso chunky slab-serif title on two lines, exact "Byte by" then "Byte". Small clean sans above title: "BYTEFRONT STUDIO". Below title: "Look closer." Off-white slight offset under large title, like the film. Two small coral four-point print stars maximum, and a grounded horizontal rule. Keep generous margins, no frame, no subtitle card, no excessive icons.
Only text: "BYTEFRONT STUDIO", "Byte by Byte", "Look closer."
No schedule, no Weekly, no dates, no clocks, no publication info. Match identity exactly, curious adult not baby. One finished title frame, no storyboard panels or device mockup.
prompts.espresso-id-keyframe-v03:
Use case: logo-brand, illustration-story.
Create one PORTRAIT 9:16 video identity keyframe for the technology Shorts series Bytefront Espresso, in the exact midcentury printed educational cartoon style of input 2 and the character identity of input 1.
Input 1 fixes the adult human identity: broad bean head, crooked three-tuft dark hair, uneven brows, ivory oval eyes, long blunt triangular skin-colored nose, teal crewneck with one mustard hem patch on his left front, navy trousers and cream shoes. Reuse this exact person, not a younger child.
Input 2 fixes the primary style: flat faded colors, dark brown dry contours, slightly offset solid ink fills, restrained paper grain, simple geometric shapes. No gradients or volumetric painting.
Composition: dusty blue paper background. At upper middle, small sans text "BYTEFRONT" followed by large chunky slab-serif "Espresso" over TWO lines only if necessary, but prefer one line fitting width. Under it smaller clean sans "Tech Shorts". Middle/lower center: the same curious, slightly awkward stocky adult leans forward gripping a coral news card with both hands. News card uses three simple cream horizontal printed bars and one small mustard circle ONLY, no invented headline. Hands have clear contact and outline. Character is 3/4 full body with shoes visible, grounded on a short espresso ink line. One small coral four-point star upper left of card.
Put all critical text/face/card well inside the central 76% width, within y=15%..72% of canvas. Bottom 20% remains quiet blue paper for Shorts controls. Top 10% quiet too. No phone frame, no player buttons, no subscribe, no fake UI, no weekday, no weekly, no clock or schedule.
Text verbatim: "BYTEFRONT", "Espresso", "Tech Shorts".
Deliver one portrait finished title keyframe, not multiple panels.
